art_direction: 深靛盘发女性在雨后廊下收起小伞，雨链与湿石地呈现安静清润的夏天。
composition_variation: Create an original high-quality 2D anime illustration of one beautiful 30-year-old adult woman with youthful adult vitality and a mature, self-assured presence. Her adult features include thoughtful slate-blue eyes, arched brows, a refined nose, and a quiet contented smile. Deep-indigo hair is gathered in a loose low bun. Dress her in an opaque soft-apricot short-sleeved blouse, charcoal relaxed culottes, and low walking shoes. Under the shelter of a courtyard eave, she holds a closed compact umbrella vertically with both hands near her waist, listening to the last drops trickling down a rain chain. Her shoulders remain relaxed and her head tilts slightly toward the sound. Wet stone tiles, a ceramic water basin, and blurred leaves suggest recent summer rain. Use apricot, ink blue, soft gray, and cool green, with luminous overcast light and small, controlled wet-surface reflections. Use an eye-level camera and a calm three-quarter-length portrait. Place her centrally in the middle and lower frame, entirely inside a narrow phone-safe composition; keep hands close to her torso. Reserve the upper 25% as uncluttered light atmosphere for the lock-screen clock. Natural anatomy, opaque clothing, no text, no logos, no additional people.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved outside the repository in Codex task artifact directory heroine-v2-ninety/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized.

wallpaper.visual_review_notes: Compressed contact sheet inspected: red-haired woman with plum vase, pale-green braid through moon gate, dark updo listening to rain chain, brunette crafting pressed-leaf bookmark, silver-haired woman on garden bridge, auburn braid watering bonsai. Adult anime figures, distinct facial designs and hands, opaque summer clothing, usable clock areas. No unwanted people, text or obvious anatomy errors.
